Company Description
In the fast-growing economies of the world, there's a new generation of ambitious younger people eager to gain financial independence and we’re here to make this potential a reality by empowering them with the Freedom to Succeed.
We empower them with guidance, tools, and easy market access so they can trade and invest with confidence. We aim to make our clients their own wealth manager: empowered to create investment strategies and make investment decisions effortlessly, in their own time, on their own terms, in their own way.
Founded in 1998 to offer online trading for retail clients, the Exinity Group is now over 25 years old and has provided leveraged trading to over 2 million customers through our global power brands, including FXTM and Nemo, giving them access to equity, commodity and FX markets across the Middle East, Asia, and Africa.
Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with central offices in the UAE, Cyprus and the UK, plus a number of smaller hubs globally. We’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company.

Job Description
1. Campaign build, management and account health
• Build and upload campaigns and assets across Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and App campaigns using the platform UI and Google Ads Editor.
• Manage assigned campaigns and markets day to day, including settings, targeting, bids, budgets, optimisation goals, ad copy and asset updates.
• Execute fast, accurate bulk builds, bulk edits and structural changes in Google Ads Editor.
• Maintain account hygiene through naming conventions, labels, URL checks, disapproval checks, pre-launch QA, change logs and regular health reviews.
• Identify and implement optimisation opportunities without prompting, including bid-strategy changes, bid adjustments, channel or placement exclusions and wider account-health actions.
• Use Google Asset Studio where appropriate to create practical asset variations; ownership of full creative production remains with the creative team.
2. Search-term and keyword analysis
• Implement scripts and AI tools integrations to review search-term data regularly to identify irrelevant traffic, emerging demand, new keyword opportunities and changes in user intent.
• Implement scripts and AI tools integration to build and maintain negative keyword coverage at the appropriate account, campaign and ad-group level.
• Implement scripts and AI tools integratio to expand and refine keyword portfolios using query evidence, performance and market-specific search behaviour.
• Assess match-type performance, query quality, duplication and routing to improve relevance and control.
• Translate findings into clear actions across keywords, ad groups, copy, landing pages, bids and campaign structure.
3. Budget pacing and forecasting
• Monitor spend against approved market and campaign plans, maintaining an accurate pacing view.
• Flag over- or underspend risk early, explain the cause and recommend corrective action.
• Reallocate budget within agreed guardrails based on performance, delivery opportunity and business priority.
• Provide short-term spend forecasts and month-end outlooks, clearly stating assumptions and delivery risks.
• Escalate material budget, tracking or inventory constraints before they affect delivery.
PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT
4. Creative and asset performance
• Analyse ad and asset performance by campaign, market, audience, format and funnel stage where data is available.
• Identify winning and underperforming hooks, messages, propositions, calls to action, formats and variations.
• Convert performance findings into clear test hypotheses and prioritised recommendations.
• Brief the creative team on new concepts, copy directions and asset variations, including the objective, audience, insight, message, format, required versions and success metric.
• Track new assets from briefing through launch and post-test analysis, documenting learning for future iterations.
• Maintain sufficient asset variety and refresh cadence to support Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and App activity.
5. Landing-page performance
• Monitor post-click performance and conversion rates using available analytics, segmented by campaign, keyword or query, audience, device, market and landing page where useful.
• Identify likely friction points, message mismatch, weak intent alignment, broken journeys or page-performance issues that may suppress conversion.
• Check destination URLs and campaign-to-page alignment as part of launch and ongoing QA.
• Brief CRO, web or product teams on evidence-based landing-page test opportunities; this role supports analysis and briefing rather than owning the full CRO roadmap or page development.
• Evaluate landing-page test results alongside media metrics to determine whether changes improve both conversion efficiency and traffic quality.
6. Competitor monitoring
• Monitor observable competitor search presence, messaging, offers, claims and landing-page approaches in priority markets.
• Track material changes that may affect impression share, click costs, brand defence, generic performance or user expectations.
• Summarise findings without presenting estimated competitor activity as confirmed fact.
• Turn competitor observations into practical recommendations for keyword coverage, copy, offers, landing pages, bidding or structured tests.
7. Structured testing
• Maintain a prioritised test backlog across ads and assets, keywords and match types, bidding, campaign settings, audiences and landing pages.
• Define a clear hypothesis, control and variant, primary success metric, guardrails and expected decision before launch.
• Configure Google Ads experiments or other agreed test designs, validate setup and protect data quality during the test.
• Interpret results with appropriate caution, distinguish directional findings from conclusive results and document limitations.
• Record outcomes, decisions and next actions so learnings can be reused across markets.
• Support incrementality and lift tests through configuration, QA and data collection under the direction of the PPC lead or measurement team.
DELIVERY, MEASUREMENT AND GOVERNANCE
8. Tracking and measurement
• Maintain working knowledge of conversion tracking across front-end and server-side events.
• Validate Google Ads tags and diagnose broken, missing, duplicated or misfiring conversions; no full GTM setup ownership is required.
• Support implementation, validation and troubleshooting of Enhanced Conversions and Enhanced Conversions for Leads.
• Work with analytics or MarTech partners to resolve tracking issues and confirm that optimisation signals remain fit for purpose.
• Understand the relationship between platform conversions, downstream quality and value metrics, and flag material discrepancies.
9. Reporting and analysis
• Run weekly analysis for assigned markets and identify the main performance drivers, blockers and risks independently.
• Produce clear, concise reporting covering performance versus target, budget pacing, material changes, areas of focus and planned optimisations.
• Move beyond descriptive commentary by translating analysis into prioritised recommendations, owners and next actions.
• Use spreadsheets confidently for pivots, lookups, reconciliations and large platform exports.
• Maintain clear documentation for tests, budget changes, structural changes and material optimisation decisions.
10. Multi-market delivery and agency QA
• Optimise multi-language accounts with appropriate consideration of local copy, keywords, search behaviour and market nuance.
• Coordinate translations and local validation where needed; do not rely on unreviewed machine translation for market-facing copy.
• Turn around agreed ad hoc market requests to deadline while protecting planned priorities.
• QA agency output in assigned markets against agreed build, tracking, compliance and reporting standards.
• Escalate conflicts in market priority, resource or deadline risk promptly.
11. Compliance and governance
• Monitor and resolve ad and asset disapprovals, escalating policy or legal questions through the correct internal route.
• Maintain advertiser verification and certification status where required.
• Follow approved claims, disclaimers, landing-page and market restrictions, and maintain an auditable record of material changes.
• Apply disciplined pre-launch and post-launch QA, including naming, targeting, budgets, bidding, URLs, assets, conversion goals and policy status.
12. Ways of working
• Communicate proactively with the line manager on progress, blockers, decisions and deadline risk.
• Organise concurrent market priorities effectively and deliver to agreed timelines.
• Collaborate effectively with creative, CRO/web, analytics, MarTech, compliance and agency partners while retaining clear ownership of PPC execution.
• Stay current with relevant Google Ads product changes and apply new capabilities only where they support agreed objectives and controls.

Qualifications
• 3+ years of hands-on paid search experience, ideally in a high-competition or complex vertical.
• Proven delivery across Google Ads Search, Performance Max and Demand Gen, with practical exposure to asset-led campaign management.
• Advanced working ability in Google Ads Editor, including bulk builds, bulk edits and structural changes.
• Strong search-term and keyword-management capability, including negative keywords, match types, query-quality analysis and keyword expansion.
• Ability to manage campaigns and identify and implement account optimisations independently.
• Practical budget pacing and short-term forecasting skills, including early identification of over- or underspend risk.
• Strong performance-analysis skills and the ability to produce actionable weekly reporting.
• Ability to analyse creative and asset performance and brief new concepts or variations to a creative team.
• Ability to assess landing-page performance and brief evidence-based improvements without requiring full CRO ownership.
• Working knowledge of conversion tracking, Google Ads tags and GTM troubleshooting; full GTM setup is not required.
• Strong spreadsheet skills, including pivots, lookups and handling large data exports.
• Structured testing mindset: clear hypotheses, success metrics, reliable setup, careful interpretation and documented learning.
• Clear written communication for senior reporting and partner briefs.
• Disciplined QA, documentation and change-control habits.
• Deeper experience across Demand Gen, YouTube and App campaigns.
• Microsoft Advertising platform and Editor experience.
• AppsFlyer or an equivalent mobile measurement partner, including event mapping, attribution windows and familiarity with SKAN.
• Experience advertising financial services under Google's restricted-category requirements, including advertiser verification, certification and claims that may trigger disapprovals.
• Multi-market and multi-language account-management experience.
• GA4 and Looker Studio experience.
• Experience using Google Ads experiments and interpreting inconclusive or directional results appropriately.
• Awareness of AI-led search developments, including AI Max and account structures that support algorithmic bidding.
• Experience using auction, market or competitive-insight tools to support observable competitor monitoring.
• Experience working with downstream value or quality signals, mobile attribution or value-based bidding.
• Experience with building scripts and utilization of AI tools to automate workflows.

Additional Information
IN SCOPE

Hands-on build and optimisation; search-term and keyword management; budget pacing; reporting; creative and landing-page analysis; briefs to specialist teams; test execution; tracking diagnosis; campaign QA; disapproval management; and multi-market delivery.
NOT THE PRIMARY OWNERChannel strategy, full creative production, the CRO roadmap, website development, full GTM implementation, legal or policy interpretation, advanced measurement design, or final cross-market budget strategy. The specialist contributes evidence and executes agreed actions in these areas.

Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 125 million users and offering access to over 2M crypto tokens, 100+ tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, FX, and precious metals such as gold. The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI agent, which co-pilots trade execution.

Bitget is driving crypto adoption through strategic partnerships with LALIGA and MotoGP™. Aligned with its global impact strategy, Bitget has joined hands with UNICEF to support blockchain education for 1.1 million people by 2027. Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.

What you'll do

• Customer Risk Rating (CRR): Design, calibrate and maintain the customer risk rating methodology, covering risk factors (geography, product, channel, occupation/source of funds, on-chain exposure, behavior), weighting, scoring and segmentation. Run back-testing and sensitivity analysis, and recalibrate when products, markets or typologies change.
• EDD Triggers & Prioritization: Define data-driven EDD triggers and risk-based queue prioritization so that analyst effort goes to the highest-risk customers. Measure EDD outcomes and feed them back into the CRR model.
• KYC Refresh Strategy: Build the risk-tiered periodic refresh schedule and event-driven refresh triggers (e.g., behavior change, new high-risk exposure, screening hits, document expiry). Size refresh backlogs, forecast workload and track completion and overdue rates by entity.
• Screening Optimization: Tune name and payment screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media), including fuzzy-matching thresholds, transliteration and alias handling, and list coverage. Run above/below-the-line testing to cut false positives without creating coverage gaps, and document the rationale for every threshold change.
• Monitoring & Typology Analytics: Combine KYC, transaction and blockchain analytics data to detect higher-risk patterns (e.g., linked accounts, mule networks, nested exchange exposure), using graph or network analysis where useful.
• Model Governance & Explainability: Own model documentation, validation, change logs and ongoing performance monitoring in line with model risk management expectations. Make sure every score and decision is explainable to analysts, auditors and regulators.
• AI-Assisted Review: Work with the Compliance Product team on ML/LLM-assisted alert triage, adverse media classification and EDD case summarization. Define evaluation sets, quality metrics and human-in-the-loop thresholds.
• Metrics & Reporting: Define and report control effectiveness and efficiency metrics: risk distribution by entity, false-positive rate, alert-to-case and case-to-SAR/STR conversion, handling time, refresh SLA adherence and QA results. Provide data for compliance committees, regulatory exams and audits.

What you'll need

• 4+ years in data science or advanced analytics, including 2+ years on financial crime, AML/KYC, fraud or credit risk at a crypto exchange, fintech, bank or payments company.
• Hands-on experience building or calibrating customer risk rating models, screening thresholds or transaction monitoring scenarios, including below-the-line testing.
• Strong SQL and Python; solid foundations in statistics, classification/scoring models, experiment design and model performance measurement.
• Working knowledge of AML/CFT, KYC/KYB, EDD, sanctions/PEP screening and risk-based approach expectations (e.g., FATF guidance), and how they translate into data and model requirements.
• Experience documenting models for validation, audit or regulatory review, and explaining model logic to non-technical compliance stakeholders.
• Ability to work with messy, multi-source data (onboarding, transactions, on-chain, vendor screening results) and to define the data quality checks needed for reliable controls.

Oversee hot wallet balances to keep the right level of funds available for deposits and withdrawals, while managing custody and security risks

Manage, coach, and develop a team of settlement analysts: set shift schedules, assign work, run performance reviews, and keep coverage solid across weekends, holidays, and night shifts

Partner with Customer Experience, Treasury, Finance, Compliance, Risk, and Engineering to resolve issues, and support product changes that affect on-chain operations

Make sure operations meet internal policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards, and support internal and external audits as needed

Flexible and open to working possible on-call across various shift rotations (morning, mid, and graveyard shifts)

Perform other related duties and ad hoc tasks as may be required from time to time

•

Graduate of Business Management, Entrepreneurship, Operations Management, Finance, or equivalent

Solid working knowledge of blockchain transactions, wallets, and crypto networks (for example, confirmations, gas fees, and network congestion), plus a strong interest in Web3

Hands-on experience with institutional custody platforms such as Fireblocks (or similar, e.g., BitGo, Copper).

Proven experience managing and developing a team in a 24/7 or shift-based operation

Track record of improving processes, building SOPs, and running operational KPIs

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; advanced in Google Workspace, especially Sheets (SQL or data tool experience is a plus)

Uphold a strong security mindset in all wallet and settlement activities: follow access controls and approval workflows, protect sensitive data, and stay alert to phishing, fraud, and suspicious transactions

Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Filipino, and comfortable presenting to stakeholders and management

Able to influence and work well with cross-functional teams

Trustworthy and able to protect confidential information with discretion

Meticulous and detail-oriented while keeping the bigger operational picture in view

Amenable to working weekends and holidays, and to mid-shift or night shift as needed

Has a track record of getting things done: drive, ownership, and execution are at the core of our culture

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Choose the right bets. Identify the client segments and problems worth solving. Own the roadmap and allocate effort against expected client value, commercial impact, and engineering cost. Set the baseline, target, and threshold for scaling; stop weak bets.

 - Build NTU retention. Help newly transacting users build on their first transaction, discover further value, and form repeat investing and financial habits through their first weeks and months. Find where they stall and improve the steps that lead to lasting use.

 - Retain and bring back established clients. Keep active clients engaged, address signs of lapsing, and reactivate clients who have stopped. Understand how needs change with tenure, holdings, and financial goals, then deepen the client’s relationship with Kraken.

 - Make the next financial move useful. Test ways to support client intent: recurring deposits and buys, useful portfolio context, timely opportunities, or relevant Earn products. Choose from the evidence. Successful automated investing and Earn can create lasting value without frequent manual activity. Make rewards, access, and risks clear.

 - Prove the commercial impact. Track retention by cohort and segment, linking behavior to retained balances, net inflows, product adoption, and revenue. Measure active engagement through useful actions, such as reviewing a portfolio or investing, and track successful automated habits separately. Distinguish inflows from asset-price gains, establish incremental impact, account for incentives and costs, and check that gains last after promotions end.

 - Connect product and lifecycle. Partner with lifecycle marketing on push, email, web, and app journeys, from a relevant message to a useful financial action. Adapt to local payment habits and market requirements.

 - Build and ship with the team. Turn the chosen problem into prototypes, requirements, and experiments with engineering, design, and data. Bring risk, compliance, and legal partners into design decisions. Balance client impact, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed; scale what works.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Evidence that you’ve personally led consumer product changes that beat retention or expansion targets. Be ready to explain the baseline, target, result, timeframe, and your contribution, including the impact on revenue, assets, or retained balances.

 - A clear account of what changed underneath the result: component behaviors or funnel rates such as repeat deposits, return-to-transaction conversion, successful recurring investments, or reactivation. Show how you established incremental impact and whether it lasted.

 - Strong client and product judgment. You can choose a segment and problem worth pursuing, understand why clients return, hold, withdraw, or disengage, and turn that insight into a useful experience.

 - Hands-on analytical depth. You query and validate your own data, diagnose cohorts and funnels, size opportunities, and design experiments that can detect a commercially meaningful effect.

 - Commercial discipline. You can explain how market conditions, incentives, costs, and client trust affected your results, and use that evidence to decide whether an improvement is worth scaling.

 - Senior ownership from decision through delivery. You’ve owned a roadmap, made product and technical trade-offs, allocated effort, stopped weak bets, and worked effectively with engineering, design, data, lifecycle marketing, and risk/compliance partners.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with consumer investing, wealth, savings, fintech, or crypto products. Freemium gaming is nice-to-have as well.

 - Experience building recurring investment, deposit, Earn, portfolio, or goal-based experiences.

 - Experience adapting client journeys across markets and local financial behaviors.







Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address

Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/

Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

As a Senior Product Manager at Bitpanda, you will take end-to-end ownership of key product areas and strategic pillars, scaling our offerings for financial institutions, banks, and strategic partners. Operating in a high-impact, complex, and regulated environment, you will define product strategy, shape the roadmap, and act as a key sparring partner to Product Leadership.

You will work closely within a collaborative structure, allowing you to focus deeply on product architecture, scalability, and technical execution while leveraging client-facing insights to inform your roadmap. This is a global, fast-paced role requiring seamless context-switching across markets, products, and evolving regulatory frameworks.

What you'll do

• Take end-to-end ownership of core product pillars, defining the long-term vision, strategy, and execution roadmap in close alignment with Product Leadership.

• Partner with Engineering to translate complex market and partner needs into clear, actionable, and scalable technical capabilities.

• Work closely with Client Solution Leads—and engage directly with external partners when needed—to weigh client-specific requests against long-term platform scalability and strategic priorities.

• Proactively integrate fintech and financial services regulatory requirements into the product lifecycle, collaborating closely with Compliance and Legal to ensure every launch meets global standards.

• Act as a central connector across Engineering, Sales, Client Solutions, Legal, and Compliance, managing senior stakeholders and driving clarity amid ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Who you are

• Proven track record managing B2B and/or B2B2C products within finance, banking, fintech, or crypto.

• Demonstrated experience operating as a Senior Product Manager or Lead Product Manager, with end-to-end ownership of complex products.

• Solid understanding of regulatory requirements in fintech or financial services, with hands-on experience shipping compliant products in highly regulated environments.

• Ability to partner effectively with engineering teams, break down technical trade-offs, and build scalable, platform-level solutions rather than one-off customisations.

• Comfortable thinking globally, switching contexts rapidly across multiple product pillars, and navigating evolving priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to align senior internal stakeholders and engage credibly with institutional partners when required.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

SEO is how you got here. AI search is where you're headed.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

As a Treasury Program Manager - Capital Allocation on our Capital Management team, you’ll own the operating process that takes every new Kraken product from idea to launch with its capital impact understood and signed off. You’ll run intake for the New Product Capital Assessment (NPCA) and New Product Approval Process (NPAP), learn how each product and business actually works, work with our Quant team to turn that understanding into rigorous capital calculations, and make sure the results are documented, repeatable, and ready for auditors and regulators. You care as much about how a product affects our clients as about how it affects our balance sheet.

 




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Run NPCA and NPAP intake end to end: triage requests, gather product specifications, track milestones, and keep every launch on a clear, predictable timeline

 - Maintain the intake framework, including checklists, templates, risk-tiering criteria, and decision gates, and improve it as products and regulations evolve

 - Coordinate sign-offs across Product, Engineering, Quant, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Treasury, and Finance, escalating blockers early

 - Keep a complete audit trail of assumptions, approvals, and open items for every product reviewed

 - Report on pipeline status, cycle times, and capital impact to senior leadership

 - Learn each product in depth: how it’s built, how it settles, who uses it, where client assets sit, and what could go wrong

 - Work directly with Product Managers and business owners to map the full flow of client assets and exposures

 - Assess how each product and its risk controls affect clients, including liquidity, redemption, and settlement outcomes

 - Challenge assumptions constructively, and tell product teams early what a launch will require

 - Work with Quants to define, document, and validate methodologies for sizing RWA (credit, market, operational) and required capital (CET1 or GAAP equity) for each new product

 - Review and reconcile model inputs, assumptions, and outputs, and run independent sanity checks and sensitivity analysis

 - Apply capital floors and reserve requirements under frameworks such as the GENIUS Act, including operating expense backstops

 - Assess collateral adequacy, including asset quality, peg stability, and market depth, and review stress scenarios (e.g., a 50% drawdown in major crypto assets) for solvency and liquidation pathways

 - Cover crypto-specific risks in the assessment: smart-contract bugs, settlement latency, oracle manipulation, and run risk on tokenized liquidity pools

 - Map each new launch to applicable regulatory and prudential requirements with Legal and Compliance

 - Bridge the first line (Product, Quants) and second line (Risk, Compliance), and support defense of capital calculations to external auditors and banking regulators

 - Keep methodology documentation, control evidence, and process records current

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6-8+ years in capital management, risk, treasury, finance, or product control at a bank, broker-dealer, or high-growth FinTech or crypto company

 - Hands-on experience running operational processes, such as product approvals, change management, or regulatory reporting, with clear controls and documentation

 - Solid grasp of capital and RWA concepts (Basel, CET1, liquidity and reserve requirements) and the ability to work through calculations and challenge model outputs

 - Comfort working with Quants and engineers, including reading methodologies and assumptions, and asking sharp questions

 - Ability to learn products and business models quickly, and explain their risk and client impact in plain language

 - Understanding of crypto-specific risks, including smart contracts, oracles, settlement finality, stablecoins, tokenization, and DeFi mechanics

 - Working knowledge of the regulatory environment for crypto, stablecoins, and tokenized assets

 - Strong project and program management skills, and the ability to drive consensus and deadlines across many teams

 - Proficiency in Excel and SQL; Python a plus

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and rigorous attention to detail

 - Strong knowledge of, or demonstrated curiosity for, the cryptocurrency industry

As a Sr. MarTech Specialist for Attribution and Performance, you will support attribution and performance measurement at Payward by owning the data and processes that keep it accurate, and by acting as the bridge between our engineers and our performance marketing team. You will form part of a wider MarTech team and partner closely with finance and compliance so that measurement stays accurate and follows our safety and compliance practices. You will also use AI as a core part of how you work, moving quickly and sharing what you learn with the team. Key responsibilities include:

 - Attribution:
   
   - Drive attribution across web and app, covering conversion definitions, touchpoint credit and journeys stitched together across 3rd party vendors and our inhouse data platforms.
   
   - Reconcile ad platform, MMP, analytics and internal numbers, and explain the gaps in plain language.
   
   - Investigate discrepancies caused by vendor configuration, attribution methodology, fraud or bugs in our own apps.
   
   - Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to speed up investigation, SQL, specs and reporting, share what works with the team and contribute to team Agent.
   
   - Contribute to the roadmap for the next level of attribution, such as incrementality testing, LTV-based optimisation and marketing mix modelling.
   
   Engineering partnership:
   
   - Turn performance marketing needs into clear specs and tickets for engineering, covering event design, deep links, SDK changes and server-side tracking, and review what ships.
   
   - Work with engineers and data owners to keep the signals ad platforms optimise on (Meta, Google and TikTok conversion APIs and postbacks) complete, deduplicated and consent-compliant.
   
   - Audit and standardise event naming, properties and volume, with monitoring in place to catch breakages early.
   
   Performance and cross-functional support:
   
   - Run a regular rhythm with performance marketing on attribution health, discrepancies and test readouts.
   
   - Put a measurement plan in place before spend goes live on new channels, launches and tests, and own the readout afterwards.
   
   - Support weekly and monthly reporting cycles, maintain the attribution dashboards the performance team relies on, and support spend and invoice reconciliation with finance.
   
   - Work directly with MMP and ad platform reps and vendor support, escalating with evidence.
   
   - Work with compliance to keep tracking, conversion signals and reporting aligned with Payward's safety and compliance practices, including consent, privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and financial promotion rules.
   
   - Set up monitoring and alerts for tracking breakages, fraud and volatility-driven spikes in traffic and conversions, such as sharp market moves, and escalate per policy.
   
   - Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, finance, design, data and performance marketing, and prioritise requests openly.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in MarTech, performance marketing technology, growth analytics or a related digital marketing field.

 - Hands-on experience with web and mobile attribution, including MMPs (such as AppsFlyer or Branch), SKAN, deep linking and web-to-app journeys.

 - Understanding of why ad platforms credit conversions differently, and experience with conversion APIs and server-side tracking for Meta, Google Ads and TikTok.

 - Comfortable working with data: SQL and a data warehouse, able to read an event schema and trace a discrepancy back to its source.

 - An AI-native way of working: you already use AI assistants and agents day to day for analysis, SQL, scripting, documentation and automation, move fast with them, check their output before relying on it, and follow our data privacy and security rules when doing so.

 - Experience working within safety and compliance practices in a regulated environment, such as consent and financial promotion rules, and monitoring data and alerts through volatile periods when traffic and conversions swing quickly.

 - Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills, with experience aligning performance marketers, engineers, data, finance and compliance around a number they might not align on.

 - Able to write a clear spec, work with engineers to deliver it and review the result.

 - Detail-oriented and process-driven, able to manage multiple workstreams and prioritise the problems that move spend decisions.

 - Genuine interest in the crypto or fintech industry.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Exposure to incrementality testing or marketing mix modelling.

 - Experience building AI-assisted workflows or lightweight automations, for example with LLM APIs, scripts or agents, for reporting, QA or monitoring.

Topstep Brokerage gives traders a regulated home to trade their own capital on TopstepX, and we’re ready to build it into a brand traders actively choose. The Brand Marketing Manager, Brokerage turns brand strategy and top-line positioning into the evergreen campaigns, always-on messaging, and go-to-market motions that grow the brokerage business.

Our Senior Director of Brand & Communications sets the strategy, messaging framework, and positioning. You’ll own execution from there: building the always-on brand marketing engine for Topstep Brokerage, bringing Copy, Email, Creative, Social, Lifecycle, and the Brokerage team together, and moving every campaign from brief to launch. You’ll also lead a Brand Marketing Specialist, with the potential to add a Content Manager as the program grows.

Topstep Brokerage operates under strict NFA and compliance guardrails. This role is for a compliance-minded marketer who has done this work inside a regulated environment, respects the process, and still makes the work sharp, confident, and compelling.

Key Responsibilities

• Translate brand strategy and top-line messaging from the Senior Director of Brand & Communications into a clear, executable brokerage marketing plan.

• Build and run evergreen brand campaigns and always-on messaging that drive awareness, consideration, and new account growth, not just individual product launches.

• Own execution of the brokerage messaging framework and value propositions, and act as the day-to-day guardian of brokerage messaging: review work across channels and flag gaps or drift before it ships.

• Lead brokerage go-to-market launches end to end: write briefs, set timelines, and align Copy, Email, Creative, Social, Lifecycle Marketing, and the Brokerage team.

• Serve as the connective tissue between Marketing, the Brokerage business, and Legal/Compliance so every activation supports brokerage business goals.

• Brief and align channel partners to keep work moving and cohesive, while respecting channel owners as the experts on creative execution in their lanes.

• Operate fluently within Topstep Brokerage’s NFA and compliance review process, partnering with the Brokerage Project Manager to route work through approvals.

• Build what can and cannot be said about trading, performance, risk, and financial claims into briefs from the start, and maintain approved messaging, disclosure, and risk-language standards across all brokerage marketing.

• Identify growth opportunities across the trader journey, including converting existing Topstep Traders into Brokerage Customers.

• Keep campaigns organized and on schedule in Notion and compliance approval software, with clear owners, milestones, and status visibility for stakeholders.

• Define and track success metrics, including new accounts opened, prop-to-brokerage conversion, business growth, and brand awareness, and turn performance data into recommendations that shape forward strategy.

• Lead and develop the Brand Marketing Specialist, Brokerage, by setting priorities, defining scope, and providing regular feedback and coaching across social, content, and campaign execution.

• As the team grows, lead and develop a Content Manager, Brokerage, who owns content strategy and production across blogs and email.

• Use AI tools to speed up research, ideation, and content development, while applying strong judgment and craft to everything that ships.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

This is a people leadership role with one direct report (Brand Marketing Specialist, Brokerage) and room to grow the team.

• 3 + years of marketing experience at an FCM, introducing broker, broker-dealer, or other NFA or FINRA regulated financial services firm (required).

• 5-7 years of total experience in brand, product, or campaign marketing.

• Working knowledge of financial promotional rules, including NFA and FINRA communications standards and required risk disclosures. You know what needs review before anyone asks.

• A portfolio of approved, compliant work that still feels sharp and on-brand.

• Proven track record leading integrated campaigns and GTM launches from strategy through execution.

• Experience managing or mentoring at least one direct report: setting direction, giving feedback, and supporting their development. Experience building or growing a small team is a plus.

• Strong writing and messaging skills, with the ability to make regulated products feel clear and compelling.

• Highly organized, able to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines at once.

• Analytical mindset, able to connect marketing activity to business outcomes.

• Proficiency with Notion or similar project management tools.

• Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, ideation, and content development, without relying on them in place of strategic thinking or craft.

• Series 3 license is a major plus.

• Familiarity with futures trading or active trading platforms is a plus.

Company Culture & Perks

• Topstep is an engaging working environment that ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration by keeping cameras on during meetings and maintaining a robust Slack environment for communication.

• Seven Company-paid Holidays and generous Family Leave. Paid time off is front-loaded.

• Competitive 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance are offered for full-time employees.

• Derive meaningful test scenarios based on business requirements and system workflows.
• Perform functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing on tasks and epics.
• Develop and maintain an up-to-date regression pack to ensure ongoing testing of critical functionalities.

Qualitative Measures
• Demonstrate responsibility and reliability in completing assigned testing tasks.
• Actively participate in product and QA discussions within the squad, asking questions and providing feedback from a testing perspective.
• Maintain clear and effective communication with developers, product managers, and other team members regarding testing progress and issues.
• Ensure documentation in Confluence is clear, structured, and useful for the team.

Quantitative Measures

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tool.
• Ability to create and maintain test cases and QA documentation using tools like Confluence.

• Excellent attention to detail, highly organised with a proactive approach.
• Capable of working on multiple tasks simultaneously and managing deadlines.
• Relevant testing qualifications such as ISTQB, Agile software testing courses.
• Experience in API testing using Postman or similar tools.

Company Description
We believe the power of risk-driven investing can help anyone achieve a better life. And we’re here to make this potential a reality for an emerging global generation.
We provide individuals in the world’s fast-developing economies with guidance, tools, and easy market access so they can trade and invest with confidence. We aim to make our clients their own wealth manager: empowered to create investment strategies and make investment decisions effortlessly, in their own time, on their own terms, in their own way.
Our story goes back to the first days of online Forex trading - a pioneer of the Metatrader platform, Alpari, expanded rapidly in the world’s emerging markets and was joined in 2011 by our sister brand, FXTM. Now, we are adding further brands to our portfolio. Together, both brands have built a leading global presence in online trading serving over two million clients in 150 countries from regulated centres across four continents.
Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with offices across Europe, Asia and Africa, and we’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company.

Job Description
We are looking for a highly experienced QA Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our real-time trading systems in a global Forex/CFD environment.

You will work closely with developers, product teams, and dealing/risk departments to design robust automated testing frameworks for pricing, order execution, trading cores, market data feeds, risk engines, and integrations with external liquidity providers.
Responsibilities
Automated Testing
•
Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive automated test suites covering:
•
order execution flows
•
market data distribution
•
risk calculations
•
Build frameworks for deterministic simulation of trading scenarios and edge cases.
Performance & Stress Testing
•
Implement and manage stress, latency, throughput, and stability tests for:
•
trading cores
•
pricing engines
•
real-time message pipelines
•
Detect bottlenecks, resource leaks, deadlocks
Quality Engineering & Analysis
•
Analyze business requirements, trading/risk logic, and code to ensure full test coverage of critical flows.
•
Work with developers and quants to identify root causes, validate fixes, and improve system resilience.
•
Build tools to automate operational testing tasks and regression checks.
Automation Operations
•
Ensure reliability of tests in distributed environments with eventually consistent data.
•
Maintain and improve AI framework.

Qualifications
Essential
•
Extensive experience in test automation and software development (5+ years preferred).
•
Strong coding skills in Python.
•
Strong experience with AI tools and agentic approach.
•
Strong understanding of:
•
concurrent systems
•
distributed microservices
•
event-driven architectures
•
Experience testing systems that use:
•
API (REST, gRPC, GraphQL)
•
Message brokers (Kafka, NATS, Redis Streams)
•
Deep understanding of software testing principles:

functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, performance testing, non-functional requirements.
•
Strong troubleshooting skills (profiling, metrics, logs, distributed tracing).
•
Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
Nice to Have
•
Understanding of the Forex trading domain, including:
•
order types
•
execution models (A-book/B-book)
•
market data (ticks, L2)
•
risk systems (margin, exposure)
•
Experience testing FIX protocol integrations.
•
Experience with:
•
Docker/Kubernetes
•
GitLab CI/CD
•
monitoring/observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry)

Job Description
We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and service-oriented People Operations & Office Administrator to provide dedicated on-the-ground support for our growing Armenia team. This is a genuine dual role, with responsibilities expected to be split 50/50 between People Operations and Office Administration. The balance may vary during busy periods according to business needs, but candidates must be motivated to contribute fully to both areas.

The role will coordinate the local employee lifecycle from pre-employment and onboarding through employment changes, benefits, payroll inputs and offboarding. It will also ensure the Armenia office is safe, functional, well organised and welcoming. The successful candidate will work within a hybrid operating model, bringing appropriate activities in-house while coordinating closely with the local outsourcing partner, authorities, legal advisers and specialist agencies where formal oversight or expertise is required.

Key Responsibilities:
People Operations
•
Onboarding, Induction & Documentation
•
Coordinate the end-to-end local onboarding process once a candidate is ready to join, in partnership with internal stakeholders and the local outsourcing partner.
•
Prepare offer and employment documentation using approved templates; coordinate review, approval, signature and secure filing.
•
Communicate with new joiners, gather required personal and employment documents, arrange office visits and ensure all pre-employment requirements are completed on time.
•
Coordinate document movement, courier services and signatures between the company, employees and the outsourcing partner.
•
Plan and deliver local induction activities, ensuring new joiners have the information, workplace access, equipment and support needed to start successfully.
•
Maintain clear onboarding trackers and proactively follow up on dependencies, risks or delays.
•
Employee Lifecycle Administration
•
Coordinate local documentation and approvals for probation completion, contract extensions, permanent employment conversions, role changes, salary changes and other employment amendments.
•
Maintain accurate and confidential employee files, records and supporting documentation in line with company standards and local requirements.
•
Provide friendly, timely first-line support to employees on routine People Operations questions, escalating complex or sensitive matters appropriately.
•
Support the implementation of global People policies and processes in Armenia and develop sufficient knowledge to provide backup support to the wider regional People Operations team when required.
•
Monitor requests received through agreed service channels, including JIRA or equivalent case-management tools, and ensure appropriate follow-through.
•
Benefits, Leave & Payroll Inputs
•
Administer local employee benefits, including medical insurance, and support employees with routine benefit queries and documentation.
•
Coordinate local leave administration, overtime and other employee entitlements, ensuring records and required documentation are complete and accurate.
•
Gather, validate and submit monthly payroll inputs and supporting information within agreed deadlines.
•
Prepare basic People Operations reports and trackers using Excel, highlighting missing information, exceptions and upcoming actions.
•
Coordinate required documentation and signatures with the outsourcing partner while maintaining internal ownership of follow-up and employee communication.
•
Immigration & Right-to-Work Coordination
•
Act as the local coordinator for routine immigration, residency and right-to-work queries relating to Armenia.
•
Understand the basic requirements for common scenarios, including local hires, foreign nationals already in Armenia, spouses, transfers and international relocations.
•
Research requirements through reliable official sources, contact relevant authorities where appropriate and provide clear process guidance to internal stakeholders.
•
Coordinate end-to-end cases with employees, the outsourcing partner, legal advisers and specialist agencies, using external support where formal expertise or representation is required.
•
Maintain trackers for cases, documents, renewals and deadlines, and escalate compliance risks promptly.
•
Continuously build internal knowledge so routine questions can be resolved quickly without unnecessary external back-and-forth.
•
HR Systems, Data & Reporting
•
Maintain accurate employee data and records in BambooHR and other approved People systems.
•
Use SmartRecruiters where required to support employee handover from recruitment into onboarding and maintain complete documentation.
•
Complete regular data-quality checks and ensure records are accurate, current, confidential and audit-ready.
•
Maintain process guides, document templates, trackers and standard operating procedures for Armenia People Operations.
•
Use Microsoft Excel to prepare routine reports, reconciliations and status updates.
•
Offboarding
•
Coordinate local offboarding activities, documentation, approvals, signatures and employee communication.
•
Work with relevant stakeholders to arrange return of equipment, removal of access, final payroll inputs and completion of required local formalities.
•
Ensure employee files and systems are updated accurately and all actions are completed within required timelines.
•
Coordinate with the outsourcing partner and specialist advisers where formal local processes or signatures are required.
Office Administration
•
Office Administration & Facilities
•
Act as the primary local contact for the landlord, building management, vendors, contractors and workplace service providers.
•
Ensure the office remains safe, functional, fully operational, appropriately stocked and maintained to a high standard.
•
Coordinate maintenance requests, repairs, cleaning, supplies, access and day-to-day workplace requirements.
•
Manage courier and postal services, including secure movement of employee and company documents.
•
Coordinate office-related purchase orders, invoices, expenses, service contracts and supporting records.
•
Maintain accurate office documentation, supplier information and service agreements.
•
Support health, safety and workplace compliance activities in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders and external advisers.
•
Employee Experience, Events & Office Projects
•
Provide a welcoming and professional first point of contact for employees, visitors and new joiners in the Armenia office.
•
Coordinate local employee events, team gatherings and office celebrations, including venues, suppliers, budgets, logistics and on-the-ground delivery.
•
Support workplace communications and practical employee-experience initiatives.
•
Provide hands-on administrative support for future office projects, including the potential search for and transition to a new Armenia office.

Qualifications
Essential:
•
Previous experience in HR administration, People Operations, HR coordination or a comparable employee lifecycle role, combined with office administration or workplace coordination exposure.
•
Practical experience supporting onboarding, employment documentation, employee records, benefits, leave, payroll inputs and/or offboarding.
•
Basic exposure to immigration, residency, right-to-work or employment compliance processes, with the resourcefulness to research requirements and coordinate with authorities or specialist providers.
•
Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines and stakeholders.
•
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accurate, confidential and compliant record keeping.
•
Professional written and verbal communication skills in Armenian and English.
•
Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams and Word.
•
A proactive, service-oriented approach, sound judgement and the willingness to take ownership of both People Operations and Office Administration responsibilities.
•
Ability and willingness to work from the Yerevan office on a regular basis.
Desirable:
•
Experience in an international, fast-growing or multi-location organisation.
•
Experience working with an outsourced employer, payroll provider, professional employer or local HR services partner.
•
Experience with BambooHR, SmartRecruiters, JIRA or comparable HR and case-management systems.
•
Knowledge of Armenian employment administration, local authorities and common immigration or right-to-work processes.
•
Experience coordinating vendors, invoices, facilities, events or office moves.
•
Experience preparing basic HR reports, payroll reconciliations or operational dashboards.
Personal Attributes
•
Balanced interest in both People Operations and Office Administration, without viewing either side as secondary.
•
Approachable, dependable and comfortable supporting employees with day-to-day questions.
•
Resourceful and confident finding accurate information, asking the right questions and following issues through to resolution.
•
Comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes are being brought in-house and responsibilities will mature over time.
•
Collaborative and able to work effectively with local colleagues, global People teams, vendors, advisers and outsourced partners.
•
Committed to continuous learning and capable of developing greater ownership with guidance.

Additional Information
Measures of Success
•

About Prime

Prime is our B2B platform for businesses and institutions that move money between fiat and crypto. In one account, clients get access to institutional liquidity, on- and off-ramp, payments and settlement. Our clients are payment institutions, EMIs and PSPs, trading desks, market makers, brokers and corporates. They use Prime to source liquidity, convert between fiat and crypto, settle with their own clients and partners, and manage how their money moves across jurisdictions.

The role

You will own Prime as a product: what we build, why, in what order and how it makes money. You sit between engineering, sales and the business. You set the strategy and the roadmap, and you can also go deep enough into requirements and architecture to make sure the team builds the right thing.

This is not a backlog-administration role. We need a product owner who understands institutional clients as well as understands the system behind the product.

What you will do

Strategy and roadmap

• Own the Prime product strategy and roadmap across liquidity, on/off-ramp, payments and settlement.

• Prioritise by client value, revenue, regulatory requirements and technical effort - and explain the trade-offs.

• Shape the product for each region, taking into account local regulation, banking partners and client needs.

Clients and business

• Work with sales and directly with clients to understand how institutions and corporates use Prime: liquidity sourcing, conversion, settlement flows and treasury needs.

• Shape the commercial side of the product: fee and pricing structures, spreads, partner and revenue-share models, and the product’s impact on P&L.

• Turn client and partner requests into product decisions, not one-off customisations.

Requirements and delivery

• Turn business needs into clear requirements: use cases, edge cases, flow of funds, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineering on solution design. Understand the main components - liquidity aggregation and execution, wallets and custody, fiat payment rails, ledger and balances, reporting, API - and how they connect.

• Run priorities, backlog and release planning together with engineering; be the main link between tech, sales, compliance and operations.

Compliance, operations and metrics

• Turn regulatory and operational requirements - KYB/AML, safeguarding, reporting, regional licence conditions - into product flows, together with Compliance, Legal and Operations.

• Define and track product metrics: volume, active clients, revenue, conversion and settlement time.

What we are looking for

Product and technical

• 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager owning a B2B product end to end in fintech, payments, banking, brokerage or crypto.

• A strong technical product background: you can discuss system architecture, APIs, data flows and integrations with engineers, and write requirements they can build from.

• Experience setting product strategy and a roadmap, not only managing delivery.

Domain and business

• A clear understanding of how money moves: payments, fiat rails (e.g. SEPA, SWIFT, Faster Payments, wires), settlement, reconciliation and safeguarding of client funds.

• Understanding of liquidity and trading basics: spot and OTC trading, spreads, liquidity providers, on/off-ramp.

• Commercial thinking: pricing, fees, unit economics, partner and revenue-share models.

• Experience building products for institutional or corporate clients - PSPs, EMIs, brokers, trading firms or corporates.

• You connect technology and business, and you are comfortable with both.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with crypto or digital-asset products: exchanges, OTC desks, custody, stablecoins or on/off-ramp.

• A background in engineering, business analysis or solution architecture.

• Experience working with liquidity providers, banks or payment partners.

Anti-Money Laundering Officer (AMLO) – MiCAR / Crypto

1. Purpose of the Role

The Anti-Money Laundering Officer ("AMLO") is the designated key function holder responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving all policies, systems, and processes to counter the risks of the Company's involvement in money laundering, terrorism financing, bribery, and corruption. The AMLO serves as the central point of contact — both internally and externally — for all matters related to AML/CFT compliance.

This role is established in accordance with the Austrian Financial Market Anti-Money Laundering Act (FM-GwG), MiCAR (Regulation (EU) 2023/1114), the Austrian MiCA-VVG, and the FMA's published governance requirements for obliged entities.

2. Key Responsibilities

2.1 AML/CFT Framework & Compliance

•

Design, implement, and maintain the AML/KYC/CFT compliance framework across all business functions

•

Develop and update AML/CFT policies, procedures, and internal controls

•

Ensure rigorous implementation of the framework across the Company, including outsourced functions

•

Monitor regulatory developments and ensure sustained compliance with Austrian and EU AML/CFT requirements

2.2 Risk Management

•

Conduct and maintain the Company's Money Laundering/Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment

•

Identify and assess ML/TF risks related to customers, geographies, products, services, and technologies

•

Implement enhanced due diligence measures for high-risk scenarios (PEPs, complex structures, high-risk jurisdictions)

•

Ensure that ML/TF risks are considered in the development of new products, the taking-on of new customers, and changes to the business profile

2.3 Monitoring & Detection

•

Oversee behavior and transaction monitoring systems

•

Supervise the implementation and effectiveness of automated monitoring tools and alert management

•

Ensure adequate processes for detecting unusual or suspicious activities

2.4 Reporting

•

Act as the primary liaison with the Austrian Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU, A-FIU at the Federal Ministry of the Interior)

•

File Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) as required — independent of management instruction when exercising this function

•

Report at least quarterly to the Board of Directors on relevant events, findings, and compliance status in a formal report

•

Escalate key/high-risk compliance issues within the governance structure

2.5 Sanctions Compliance

•

Oversee sanctions screening processes and systems

•

Ensure compliance with applicable EU and national sanctions regimes

•

Coordinate with the Sanctions Officer on matters of overlapping responsibility

2.6 Training & Awareness

•

Design, implement, and oversee AML/CFT training programs for all staff

•

Ensure staff in relevant functions receive adequate and regular training

•

Promote awareness of AML/CFT obligations and red flags across the organization

2.7 Outsourcing Oversight

•

Supervise and control all outsourced AML/CFT functions (incl. shared AML services at AT Holding level and third-party tools)

•

Ensure that outsourcing arrangements do not impair the Company's AML/CFT compliance

2.8 Second Line of Defense

•

Lead and supervise the second line of defense regarding AML/CTF, bribery, and corruption

•

Work in close cooperation with the Head of Compliance on compliance matters

•

Coordinate with the COO on client onboarding and KYC processes

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Finance Manager to join our Finance team in the United Kingdom. Working alongside the EMEA Financial Controller, you will play a key role in delivering financial reporting, financial controls, statutory accounts and regulatory finance across Axi's EMEA entities, including our FCA-regulated UK entity, CySEC-regulated Cyprus entity and UK service entities.

This is an opportunity for an experienced finance professional who combines strong technical accounting and regulatory expertise with a practical, improvement-focused mindset. You will take ownership of financial processes, work closely with international stakeholders and help transform how finance operates through automation, technology and better data integrity.

Your EDGE Assignment/You Will

•

Financial Reporting & Control: Prepare and review the EMEA month-end close in line with Group timelines, covering bank and payment provider journals, client ledger and broker journals, rebates, profit share, intercompany transactions, FX revaluation and VAT.

•

Trading P&L: Reconcile trading and hedging revenue against back-office and broker records, supporting segmental analysis across entities and products.

•

Balance Sheet Management: Own balance sheet reconciliations, establish review cadences and escalation processes, and manage aged items, client debt and negative balance provisioning.

•

Management Reporting: Prepare management accounts and meaningful variance commentary for Group Finance and EMEA leadership, explaining the key drivers behind financial performance.

•

Statutory Reporting & Audit: Prepare statutory financial statements under IFRS and UK GAAP and manage the external audit process, including audit queries and the preparation of supporting documentation.

•

Tax Compliance: Manage the financial data supporting corporation tax, VAT and transfer pricing, working closely with external advisers and Group Tax.

•

Regulatory Finance: Prepare and review FCA and CySEC regulatory capital returns, own funds calculations and finance inputs for the ICARA and wind-down plan. Monitor capital and liquidity headroom and escalate potential concerns early.

•

Client Money & Cash: Oversee daily and monthly client money, safeguarding and cash reconciliations in collaboration with the Manila team, including exception reviews, aged items and breach assessment inputs.

•

Finance Transformation & Automation: Identify opportunities to automate manual processes across month-end close, reconciliations and regulatory reporting using Claude, Sage Intacct and the Group data platform (Azure Databricks).

•

Data Integrity & AI Controls: Ensure reported financial numbers can be traced back to their original sources. Apply appropriate review standards, supporting evidence and clear controls when using AI-assisted finance processes.

•

People & Stakeholder Management: Provide direction to the Finance Accountant in Cyprus and the Cash Reconciliations Team Leader in Manila, initially through a dotted-line reporting structure, with the potential to move to direct reporting after 12 months, subject to performance.

•

Group Collaboration: Work closely with the EMEA Financial Controller, Group Financial Controller, Group Finance, Treasury, Compliance, Risk, external auditors and regulators. Support Group-wide projects and finance transformation initiatives.

Are you the one?

•

A qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with approximately 6–10 years of post-qualified experience.

•

Currently working as a Finance Manager or Senior Finance Manager within banking, financial services or an LSE-listed group, ideally in a regulated environment.

•

Demonstrable end-to-end ownership of month-end close and statutory reporting cycles, with experience preparing financial numbers rather than only reviewing them.

•

Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP, including hands-on experience preparing statutory accounts and managing external audits.

•

Direct experience with regulatory capital reporting under FCA, CySEC or a comparable regulatory framework.

•

Experience working in regulated financial services, banking, investment firms, payments businesses or complex financial services environments.

•

Strong understanding of financial controls, balance sheet reconciliations, management reporting and audit requirements.

•

Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and trace financial data back to source.

•

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

•

A proactive, self-driven mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

•

Comfortable managing competing priorities and delivering to deadlines in a fast-paced, global environment.

Experience leading or developing people, including remote or offshore teams, would be valuable.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

As an Affiliate Specialist for Kraken Pro, you will support the growth and day-to-day operations of the Kraken Pro affiliate program by identifying and onboarding new partners with a focus on regional Influencers and Creators; and by owning the operational processes that keep the program running accurately and compliantly. Key responsibilities include:

 

Partner recruitment:

 - Source and prospect new affiliate partners across Influencers, media publishers, mobile networks, incentive sites, social network partnerships, CTV, etc.

 - Draft and send personalized outreach.

 - Manage the partner pipeline from first contact through onboarding.

 - Support partner vetting and scoring processes (for example, mobile network partner intake and evaluation).

 - Assist with go-to-market/launch coordination for new affiliate partners, briefs, newsletters, and creative asset delivery.



Affiliate operations:

 - Own day-to-day Impact.com http://Impact.com platform administration, partner account setup, tracking link QA, and commission structure updates.

 - Support weekly, monthly reporting cycles (QuickSite, AppsFlyer, Hex exports), feeding the Pro performance dashboard and updates.

 - Monitor for compliance and fraud flags (performance benchmark violations, PID marketplace prohibitions) and escalate per policy.

 - Support invoice and payment reconciliation with acceleration partners and finance.

 - Maintain partner creative assets, records, contracts, and documentation (compliance matrix, partner type reference tables).



Cross-functional support:

 - Coordinate with agencies on day-to-day partner servicing and escalations.

 - Assist with ad hoc analysis and dashboard maintenance.

 - The program scales: support in the affiliate strategy development.

 - Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, design, martech, and analytics.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2+ years of experience in Influencer or affiliate marketing, partnerships, growth marketing, or a related digital marketing field.

 - Strong written communication skills for partner outreach and relationship management.

 - Comfortable working with data.

 - Detail-oriented and process-driven, able to manage multiple partner relationships and workstreams concurrently.

 - Genuine interest in the crypto or fintech industry.

 - A strong understanding of the local finance creator landscape and existing relationships with these influencers.

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Exposure to SQL or BI tools (Hex, QuickSight).

 - Familiarity with affiliate platforms (Impact.com http://Impact.com or similar) and attribution tools (AppsFlyer).

 - Fintech or crypto experience.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments Team, based in the US. Payments is where OKX meets the real financial world. Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. That platform moves and safeguards user assets at institutional scale, continuously, across time zones and regulatory environments.

This is not a greenfield team looking for its footing. The team is established, the platform is in production at scale, and we are actively expanding — both in scope and in headcount. That combination is rare: you get the leverage of joining a growing team where your work visibly shifts the roadmap, along with the discipline that comes from a system already trusted with real money.

It's also an unusually good place to learn. Payments is a domain that's hard to pick up from the outside — every market has its own rails, its own settlement behavior, its own failure modes, its own compliance expectations. Here you'll work across a wide range of payment methods and channels, and you'll build the judgment that comes from operating financial systems where the stakes are real: how to design for correctness when money is on the line, how to reconcile, how to recover, how to keep a platform observable enough that you find problems before your users do.

You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and partner-facing teams, and you'll set the technical bar for the engineers around you — through design docs, code reviews, and the everyday habit of doing things properly when nobody's watching.

If you like the sound of a team where the problems are genuinely hard, the standard is high, and your opinion changes the outcome, we'd like to talk.

• Protect user assets. Build for correctness first: consistency, idempotency, reconciliation, failure recovery, and the operational tooling that lets us stand behind every transaction.

• Solve the hard problems. Investigate complex distributed-systems challenges and drive them to resolution rather than handing them off.

• Partner across functions. Work with product, design, and partner teams across regions to turn ambiguous requirements into shipped systems, and to unblock dependencies before they become delays.

• Grow the team’s capability. Mentor engineers and share what you learn. Seniority here is measured in leverage, not just output.

• Stay curious. Keep pace with a fast-moving industry and bring the good ideas back.

• Collaborate directly with Mandarin-speaking partners, vendors, and clients to manage daily communications, gather project requirements, and resolve operational issues.

• A track record of shipping in a regulated, high-stakes domain at real scale
